query: Add a notes page: I type a note, press Add, and it appears in a list under the box.
expected_behavior: Makes the notes a shared document from the start (registerDoc in notes-api.ts, openDoc in notes.ts), not HTTP routes and not a 'live' feature added later
Makes src/resources/notes/ with notes-api.ts, notes.ts and notes-view.tsx, registers the document in startServer and puts the view in a route in src/app.tsx
Adds with add /notes/- and removes by id; never sets notes.data or adds the note locally: the change that comes back draws it
Renders the list with list() keyed by id, and binds signals ({x}, x$.map) rather than calling .get() in JSX
Tests what a person sees: a second window sees a note added, a refused change says Not saved; bun test passes at 100% coverage and bun run typecheck is clean
Adds a CHANGELOG.md entry under [Unreleased]

query: Customers pick from our menu and build an order. The kitchen should see every order as it comes in, and a customer should be able to undo their last change.
expected_behavior: Designs from the action: the order page holds two documents (the menu and the customer's order), and the kitchen is a document over every order
Keeps them in SQLite with delta's backend, because the kitchen and every order share rows; the schema follows from the documents
Turns on the ledger ({ ledger: true }) for undo rather than keeping an undo stack of its own
A test shows a line added to an order reaching the kitchen's document, and an undo taking it back from both
bun test passes at 100% coverage and bun run typecheck is clean

query: Let people upload a photo and get a link to it.
expected_behavior: Serves files over HTTP routes with Bun.s3, not as a document: a file is not communication
Installs no AWS SDK; startServer takes the S3 client as an option so tests pass their own
Tests against a stand-in bucket: a put, a GET that redirects to the file, and a 404 for one that is not there
bun test passes at 100% coverage and bun run typecheck is clean

query: The order page is live and people have orders in it. Now an order should count an item: two teas are one line with a quantity of 2, not two lines. Don't lose anyone's order.
expected_behavior: Declares quantity in the schema, then lets `delta migrations make` write the next migration (an addColumn), and adds beside it an up that folds an order's lines of one item into one, with its count
Keeps the history from empty: migrate runs it at start-up, with the resource's app and schema, before any document opens; no createTables
Tests an upgrade: a database as the earlier version left it, with lines in it, comes through with every order kept, and a second start runs nothing
Leaves the page and its documents as they were
bun test passes at 100% coverage and bun run typecheck is clean
